title: Understanding the Role of Gender Inequality and Food Insecurity on Maternal and Child Health
brief_summary: To pilot test a group intervention for newly married women and their households to improve nutrition, pregnancy and delivery knowledge, and intrahousehold communication
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* the household has a newly married couple (married in the last 3 months)
* a living mother-in-law
* both the woman and man being over the age of 18

Exclusion Criteria:

* Under 18
* not recently married
